The SurfaceFlinger renderer composites game frames directly through your device's display hardware, bypassing the GL/Vulkan compositor.

On some devices and SoCs this can fault the display/GPU driver and REBOOT your device — possibly losing unsaved game progress or corrupting the container. It is validated only on recent Adreno GPUs.

Use at your own risk.
Scroll to the end to continue.
